resources.string: The experimental model is only for studying the relative shape of curves. It cannot yet accurately predict your own serum estradiol level and must not be used to adjust your dose yourself.
Legacy PK (official model) on the same sublingual estradiol doses, divided by its own response 1 h after 1 mg
Experimental M2, candidate %1$s: divided by its own response 1 h after 1 mg
Band: range of the 15 frozen M2 candidates. This is the explored parameter set, not a 95% confidence interval, and it understates the uncertainty of the tail.
Shaded: more than 8 h since the latest dose. The shape of this tail is highly uncertain.
Candidates are listed by ID. Neither the order nor the default choice ranks accuracy.
Transit stages %1$s · fast input %2$s per h · elimination %3$s per h · slow input %4$s per h · slow share %5$s
Assumed background for reconstructing Price 1997: %1$s in that paper\'s units. A sensitivity assumption about that study only, not your baseline; it cannot be changed here.
settings at the time cannot be confirmed %1$d
What this page cannot tell you
It is not calibrated to you and has not been checked against independent people. Lab results are not used.
The share of slow absorption and the elimination rate cannot be told apart with the published data.
The curve more than about 8 to 24 hours after a dose is not reliable.
In retrospective cross-study tests M2 was not shown to do better than a simpler model. Neither curve is the accurate one.
Doses are added up linearly; this has not been verified in real individuals.
An area difference between Figure 1 and Table 1 of Price 1997 is still unexplained.
No records the experimental model can use

Only taken, non-deleted sublingual estradiol (E2) doses whose saved settings confirm the route and sublingual tier are used, from the 48-hour window and the 30 days before it. Oral estradiol, sublingual estradiol valerate and other routes are never used.
The experimental model could not be calculated for these records.
Here Legacy PK is shown as a relative curve so it can be compared with M2. Its official estimate in pg/mL or pmol/L is on the Estimated levels page.
Unit: multiples of each model’s own response 1 h after a single 1 mg dose. The two models are normalized separately, so a gap between the curves is a difference in shape, not in blood level.
Unit: pg/mL, taken from the Price 1997 Figure 1 amplitude anchor, not from the relative curve.
Literature study scenario, not a personal blood level prediction.
M2 candidate %1$s with the Price 1997 anchor (B = %2$s pg/mL, A = %3$s pg/mL)
Band: all 15 candidates, each with its own Price 1997 anchor. A scenario range, not a confidence interval.
Tap the chart to read both models at the same moment.
M2 ÷ Legacy (shape ratio, each normalized to its own 1 mg/1 h response): %1$s
More than 8 h since the latest dose: highly uncertain.
Window: 0–24 h after the chosen dose. Values include earlier doses still active and later doses inside the window. AUC by the trapezoid rule on a 1-minute grid, unit (× 1 mg/1 h response)·h.
Time of that peak, h (overlapping doses included)
Tmax of one isolated 1 mg dose, h (model property)

Amplitude A = %1$s pg/mL: the increment 1 h after 1 mg, fitted to the digitized Figure 1 means with the frozen P2-X rule. Background B = %2$s pg/mL: an assumption for reconstructing that paper, not your baseline.
Dots: Figure 1 group means read from the printed figure (6 postmenopausal women). Bars: reading widths, not the study’s SD.
Model area above B, 0–24 h: %1$s pg·h/mL
These areas disagree and the difference is still unexplained. The model follows the figure and is not forced to Table 1.
Model peak %1$s pg/mL; Table 1 Cmax %2$s ± %3$s pg/mL
Studies without a usable anchor (no pg/mL is shown for them)
Doll 2022: one time point with an unknown pre-dose baseline, so background and amplitude cannot be separated.
Rosano 1997: only 0–1 h after dosing, with an unknown baseline.
Komesaroff 1998: only 0–30 min after dosing; a 1 h amplitude would be an extrapolation.
%1$d sublingual estradiol doses (%2$s mg in total) from %3$s to %4$s. Older doses left out: %5$d.

You also have records of other routes or medicines. The official Legacy PK page includes them; the curves here cover sublingual estradiol only, so they cannot be compared directly with the official total.
After the latest recorded dose the curves assume no further dose; planned doses are not included.
